description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Artheng Engenharia e Consultoria is seeking a Software Engineer to contribute production-quality code, tests, and documentation for software applications. The role involves implementing defined features, investigating defects, and maintaining software behavior through testing and documentation.
Software Engineer implementing application features, debugging errors, and maintaining components with unit tests and Git

Responsibilities:
• Use Git to manage and review changes to the codebase
• Review logs and debugging output to isolate software errors
• Participate in code reviews and apply actionable feedback
• Improve straightforward performance or reliability issues within scope
• Implement defined application features in the selected programming language
• Add or update unit tests for code you modify
• Update application components while maintaining expected behavior

Requirements:
• Experience through coursework, internships, or personal projects is acceptable
• Understanding of functions, data structures, and common debugging techniques
• Comfort reading API documentation and existing code
• Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks in a remote team
• Basic familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows
• Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States
